```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate); library(forecast); library(knitr)
```

# Introduction and Problem Statement

Agricultural commodity prices in India change over time because of supply and
demand, seasons, weather and market conditions. These changes make it hard for
farmers, traders and consumers to plan. This project studies historical market
prices and builds time-series models to forecast future prices.

# Objectives

1. Explore historical minimum, modal and maximum prices of a commodity.
2. Identify yearly trends and seasonal patterns.
3. Compare three forecasting models: Baseline, Moving Average and SARIMA.
4. Evaluate the models with MAE, RMSE and MAPE, and forecast one year ahead.

# Dataset

- **Name:** Daily Commodity Prices India
- **Source:** Kaggle (originally from India's AGMARKNET system)
- **URL:** <https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/khandelwalmanas/daily-commodity-prices-india>
- **Content:** daily wholesale market prices (Rs per quintal) by state, district,
  market, commodity and variety.
- **Used here:** yearly files for 2015 to 2025.

# Data Preparation

Settings for the selected series are kept in one place. Change them to analyse
another commodity.

```{r config}
data_folder     <- "C:/v sem/IDS/csv"      # folder containing 2015.csv ... 2025.csv
rds_file        <- "monthly_data.rds"      # cached monthly data
selected_state     <- "Telangana"
selected_commodity <- "Brinjal"
selected_variety   <- "Brinjal"
prediction_year    <- 2026
```

Each yearly file is cleaned (invalid dates and non-positive prices removed) and
daily prices are averaged to monthly values. The result is cached in an `.rds`
file so the documentation knits quickly after the first run.

```{r load-data}
if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
  monthly_data <- readRDS(rds_file)
} else {
  monthly_data <- bind_rows(lapply(2015:2025, function(yr) {
    read_csv(file.path(data_folder, paste0(yr, ".csv")),
             col_types = cols(.default = col_guess(),
                              Arrival_Date = col_character(),
                              Min_Price = col_double(),
                              Max_Price = col_double(),
                              Modal_Price = col_double()),
             show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(Arrival_Date = as.Date(parse_date_time(Arrival_Date,
                                    orders = c("ymd", "dmy", "mdy"),
                                    quiet = TRUE))) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Arrival_Date), Min_Price > 0, Max_Price > 0,
             Modal_Price > 0) %>%
      mutate(State = trimws(State), Commodity = trimws(Commodity),
             Variety = trimws(Variety),
             Month = floor_date(Arrival_Date, "month")) %>%
      group_by(State, Commodity, Variety, Month) %>%
      summarise(Min_Price = mean(Min_Price), Max_Price = mean(Max_Price),
                Modal_Price = mean(Modal_Price), .groups = "drop")
  }))
  saveRDS(monthly_data, rds_file)
}

# Convert Rs per quintal to Rs per kg (1 quintal = 100 kg)
monthly_data <- monthly_data %>%
  select(State, Commodity, Variety, Month,
         Min_Price, Max_Price, Modal_Price) %>%
  mutate(Month = as.Date(Month),
         across(c(Min_Price, Max_Price, Modal_Price), ~ .x / 100))
```

A helper builds a continuous monthly series for one price column. Missing
months are filled by linear interpolation.

```{r helpers}
prepare_series <- function(data, price_column) {
  s <- data %>%
    group_by(Month) %>%
    summarise(Price = mean(.data[[price_column]], na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(is.finite(Price), Price > 0) %>%
    arrange(Month) %>%
    complete(Month = seq(min(Month), max(Month), by = "month")) %>%
    arrange(Month)
  s$Price <- zoo::na.approx(s$Price, na.rm = FALSE)
  s$Price <- zoo::na.locf(s$Price, na.rm = FALSE)
  s$Price <- zoo::na.locf(s$Price, fromLast = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
  s
}

selected_data <- monthly_data %>%
  filter(State == selected_state, Commodity == selected_commodity,
         Variety == selected_variety)

stopifnot(nrow(selected_data) > 0)

eda <- prepare_series(selected_data, "Min_Price") %>% rename(Minimum = Price) %>%
  inner_join(prepare_series(selected_data, "Modal_Price") %>%
               rename(Modal = Price), by = "Month") %>%
  inner_join(prepare_series(selected_data, "Max_Price") %>%
               rename(Maximum = Price), by = "Month") %>%
  mutate(Year = year(Month), MonthLab = factor(month.abb[month(Month)],
                                               levels = month.abb))
```

The selected series is **`r selected_commodity`** (variety
`r selected_variety`) in **`r selected_state`**, with
**`r nrow(eda)` monthly observations** from
`r format(min(eda$Month), "%b %Y")` to `r format(max(eda$Month), "%b %Y")`.

# Exploratory Analysis

## Summary statistics (Rs per kg)

```{r summary-table}
f <- function(x) round(c(mean(x), median(x), sd(x), min(x), max(x),
                         sd(x) / mean(x) * 100), 2)
kable(data.frame(
  Statistic = c("Mean", "Median", "Std deviation", "Lowest", "Highest",
                "Variation (CV %)"),
  Minimum = f(eda$Minimum), Modal = f(eda$Modal), Maximum = f(eda$Maximum)))
```

# Visualization

## Heatmap of modal price by month and year

```{r heatmap, fig.height=3.6}
ggplot(eda, aes(MonthLab, factor(Year), fill = Modal)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Modal, 0)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fff5eb", high = "#d94801") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Year", fill = "Rs/kg") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Average modal price per year

```{r yearly}
eda %>% group_by(Year) %>% summarise(Average = mean(Modal), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(Year), Average)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#5b9bd5") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Average, 1)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Average modal price (Rs/kg)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r eda-text, include=FALSE}
season <- eda %>% group_by(MonthLab) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(Modal), .groups = "drop")
season_hi <- season[which.max(season$m), ]
season_lo <- season[which.min(season$m), ]
yearly <- eda %>% group_by(Year) %>% summarise(a = mean(Modal), .groups = "drop")
```

On average, the modal price is highest in **`r season_hi$MonthLab`**
(Rs `r round(season_hi$m, 2)`/kg) and lowest in **`r season_lo$MonthLab`**
(Rs `r round(season_lo$m, 2)`/kg). The yearly average ranged from
Rs `r round(min(yearly$a), 2)`/kg (`r yearly$Year[which.min(yearly$a)]`) to
Rs `r round(max(yearly$a), 2)`/kg (`r yearly$Year[which.max(yearly$a)]`).

# Prediction Models

Three models are compared. The last 12 months are held out as a test set; the
models are trained on the earlier months.

- **Baseline:** every future month equals the last observed price.
- **Moving Average:** average of the last 3 months, rolled forward.
- **SARIMA:** seasonal ARIMA with a 12-month cycle, fitted on log prices with
  forced seasonal differencing (`auto.arima`, `D = 1`, `lambda = 0`).

The model with the lowest RMSE on the test set is refitted on all data to
forecast the selected year.

```{r models}
fit_sarima <- function(values, start_month) {
  s <- ts(values, start = c(year(start_month), month(start_month)),
          frequency = 12)
  fit <- tryCatch(auto.arima(s, seasonal = TRUE, D = 1, lambda = 0),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit))
    fit <- tryCatch(auto.arima(s, seasonal = TRUE, lambda = 0),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
  fit
}

ma_forecast <- function(history, h, window = 3) {
  out <- numeric(h)
  for (i in seq_len(h)) {
    out[i] <- mean(tail(history, window))
    history <- c(history, out[i])
  }
  out
}

metric_row <- function(actual, predicted, model) {
  e  <- actual - predicted
  ok <- is.finite(predicted) & actual != 0
  data.frame(Model = model, MAE = mean(abs(e)), RMSE = sqrt(mean(e^2)),
             MAPE = if (any(ok)) mean(abs(e[ok] / actual[ok])) * 100 else NA)
}

forecast_series <- function(data, price_column, year_to_predict) {
  s      <- prepare_series(data, price_column)
  stopifnot(nrow(s) >= 36)
  values <- s$Price
  start  <- min(s$Month)
  last_m <- max(s$Month)
  horizon <- (year_to_predict - year(last_m)) * 12 + (12 - month(last_m))
  stopifnot(horizon >= 1)

  train <- head(values, length(values) - 12)
  test  <- tail(values, 12)

  base_t  <- rep(tail(train, 1), 12)
  ma_t    <- ma_forecast(train, 12)
  fit_t   <- fit_sarima(train, start)
  sarima_t <- if (is.null(fit_t)) rep(NA_real_, 12) else
    as.numeric(forecast(fit_t, h = 12)$mean)

  metrics <- bind_rows(metric_row(test, base_t, "Baseline"),
                       metric_row(test, ma_t, "Moving Average"),
                       metric_row(test, sarima_t, "SARIMA"))
  ok   <- metrics[is.finite(metrics$RMSE), ]
  best <- ok$Model[which.min(ok$RMSE)]

  pred <- switch(best,
    "Baseline"       = rep(tail(values, 1), horizon),
    "Moving Average" = ma_forecast(values, horizon),
    "SARIMA"         = as.numeric(forecast(fit_sarima(values, start),
                                           h = horizon)$mean))

  all_f <- data.frame(Month = seq(last_m %m+% months(1), by = "month",
                                  length.out = horizon),
                      Price = pmax(pred, 0.01))
  list(forecast = filter(all_f, year(Month) == year_to_predict),
       metrics = metrics, best = best,
       holdout = data.frame(Month = tail(s$Month, 12), Actual = test,
                            Baseline = base_t, `Moving Average` = ma_t,
                            SARIMA = sarima_t, check.names = FALSE))
}

targets <- c(Minimum = "Min_Price", Modal = "Modal_Price", Maximum = "Max_Price")
res <- lapply(targets, function(tg) forecast_series(selected_data, tg,
                                                    prediction_year))
```

# Results

## Model comparison on the 12-month test set (errors in Rs per kg)

```{r metrics}
bind_rows(lapply(names(res), function(n)
  cbind(Price = n, res[[n]]$metrics))) %>%
  mutate(across(c(MAE, RMSE, MAPE), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r holdout-plot}
res$Modal$holdout %>%
  pivot_longer(-Month, names_to = "Series", values_to = "Price") %>%
  ggplot(aes(Month, Price, colour = Series, linewidth = Series == "Actual")) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1.4, `FALSE` = 0.7), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Test period: actual vs predicted modal price",
       x = "Month", y = "Rs per kg", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r result-text, include=FALSE}
fc <- data.frame(Month = res$Modal$forecast$Month,
                 Minimum = pmin(res$Minimum$forecast$Price, res$Modal$forecast$Price),
                 Modal   = res$Modal$forecast$Price,
                 Maximum = pmax(res$Maximum$forecast$Price, res$Modal$forecast$Price))
peak <- fc[which.max(fc$Modal), ]
low  <- fc[which.min(fc$Modal), ]
mm   <- res$Modal$metrics
best_modal <- res$Modal$best
```

For the modal price, the selected model is **`r best_modal`**. Its test RMSE is
`r round(mm$RMSE[mm$Model == best_modal], 2)` Rs/kg, compared with
`r round(mm$RMSE[mm$Model == "Baseline"], 2)` for the Baseline and
`r round(mm$RMSE[mm$Model == "Moving Average"], 2)` for the Moving Average.

## Forecast for `r prediction_year` (Rs per kg)

```{r forecast-table}
fc %>% mutate(Month = format(Month, "%b %Y"), across(-Month, ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r forecast-plot}
fc$Label <- factor(format(fc$Month, "%b"), levels = format(fc$Month, "%b"))
fc$Status <- ifelse(fc$Modal == max(fc$Modal), "Highest",
                    ifelse(fc$Modal == min(fc$Modal), "Lowest", "Other"))
ggplot(fc, aes(Label, Modal, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Modal, 1)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Highest = "#d9534f", Lowest = "#5cb85c",
                               Other = "#5b9bd5")) +
  labs(title = paste("Predicted modal price by month,", prediction_year),
       x = "Month", y = "Rs per kg", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

The highest predicted modal price is in **`r format(peak$Month, "%B %Y")`**
(Rs `r round(peak$Modal, 2)`/kg) and the lowest is in
**`r format(low$Month, "%B %Y")`** (Rs `r round(low$Modal, 2)`/kg).

# Conclusion

- The `r nrow(eda)`-month history of `r selected_commodity` in
  `r selected_state` shows a clear seasonal pattern, with the highest average
  prices in `r season_hi$MonthLab` and the lowest in `r season_lo$MonthLab`.
- On the 12-month test set, **`r best_modal`** had the lowest RMSE for the modal
  price (`r round(mm$RMSE[mm$Model == best_modal], 2)` Rs/kg).
- The advantage of SARIMA over the Baseline can be small, so forecasts are
  estimates and not guarantees. Accuracy also falls for years further from the
  last observed data.
- Limitations: the test uses only 12 months, missing months are interpolated,
  and weather or policy effects are not modelled.
- Future work: add rainfall and arrival quantities, try other models, and
  evaluate with rolling-origin cross-validation.
